name: problem_018_fused_rope_with_qk_norm_and_kv_cache_update_cuda_cpp
author: sol-baselines-handport
description: Fused per-head RMS norm + RoPE on Q/K + scatter into the KV cache. One CTA per (batch, head, seq) for the RMS+RoPE pass (128 threads per block, one element per thread); cudaMemcpyAsync clones key_cache / value_cache into the destination buffers across the full max_position_embeddings range; two scatter kernels write the rotated K and raw V into the cache_position slots. cos/sin are built inline from inv_freq * position_ids; the bf16 multiply-adds round each multiply result to bf16 before the add to match the pytorch reference's bf16-mul + bf16-add round-trip semantics.
